record.question: The mission of Defence Research Laboratory (DRL), Tezpur, the only DRDO laboratory in NE India includes
options: To excel in high altitude and agro-animal research in cold arid regions
To design, develop and evaluate; safe, nutritious and convenience food to meet the needs of Services and spin off to civil application
To develop technologies unique to local environment in the field of health and hygiene and judicious utilization of local resources for the benefit of the armed forces
To carry out design, development and evaluation of state of the art Life Support and Biomedical systems
